entry_long: ConnorsRSI (average of RSI(3), streak RSI(2), percent rank of ROC(100)) drops below 10 (5 for volatile instruments) -> buy.
entry_short: ConnorsRSI above 90 (95 volatile) signals pullback risk (short interpretation).
